<!-- Generated by genconfdocs from the config structs in server/config. Do not edit. -->

All fields are optional; empty values mean no branding is configured.

## `branding.org_name`

`string`, default `empty`

The organization name displayed in the web UI (e.g., "Acme Corp"). Empty disables organization-specific branding.

## `branding.logo_path`

`string`, default `empty`

The filesystem path to the organization's logo image. Empty disables the logo.

Accepted types: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG. Maximum size: 1 MB (maxLogoSize in server/controller/logo_image.go). The type is determined from the file's own bytes, not its extension.

Read once at startup and validated then, so a bad path fails the server rather than producing a broken image later; replacing the file needs a restart. Served from /api/branding/logo, always same-origin, so no third-party host sees the unauthenticated login page's traffic.

## `branding.login_notice`

`string`, default `empty`

A plain-text message shown on the login page before authentication. Empty disables the notice. Supports newlines for multi-line text.
